# CommerceLint

> CommerceLint is an evidence-first product-page field-coverage scanner and selected public-page diagnostic service for ecommerce stores and agencies.

Canonical site: https://priyanshchordia.com/commercelint/
Owner: Priyansh Chordia
Contact: pchordia@unsubscriber.me

## Primary actions

- Run the free browser scanner: https://priyanshchordia.com/commercelint/scanner.html
- Run the zero-dependency CLI or GitHub Action: https://priyanshchordia.com/commercelint/cli.html
- Review a sample audit: https://priyanshchordia.com/commercelint/sample-audit.html
- Sample is an automated one-page field-check report, not a bespoke manual audit.
- Pricing: Sample $1.99 (1 public URL), Lite $9.99 (up to 5), Comprehensive $19.99 (up to 15): https://priyanshchordia.com/commercelint/pricing.html
- Request a named plan: https://priyanshchordia.com/commercelint/founding-audit.html
- Checkout is not connected. Requests do not constitute an order, payment, or delivered report.
- Review the methodology: https://priyanshchordia.com/commercelint/methodology.html
- Read implementation guides: https://priyanshchordia.com/commercelint/guides/
- Check operating status: https://priyanshchordia.com/commercelint/status.html

## Free scanner

The scanner evaluates pasted public product-page HTML in the browser. It checks whether Product and Offer structured data, price, currency, availability, identifiers, canonical URLs, visible headings, descriptions, and obvious shipping or return links are present and parseable. It does not prove selected-variant state, visible-versus-structured consistency, feed or checkout agreement, policy-text consistency, HTTP status, robots directives, or rendered JavaScript behavior. URL retrieval is best effort and may use a third-party CORS retrieval service; pasted HTML is the preferred mode.

## Developer CLI and GitHub Action

The CLI checks field presence, JSON-LD parseability, identifiers, Offer fields, canonical signals, headings, descriptions, and obvious policy links. It can output JSON, Markdown, or text and enforce a minimum score in CI. It does not prove selected-variant state, visible-versus-structured consistency, feed or checkout agreement, rendered JavaScript, live HTTP status, or cross-page policy consistency.

## Paid diagnostic plans

Sample: USD 1.99, automated field-check report for 1 public product URL; no bespoke manual audit.
Lite: USD 9.99, selected public-page diagnostics for up to 5 public product URLs.
Comprehensive: USD 19.99, selected public-page diagnostics for up to 15 public product URLs.
Each price is a one-time report. See pricing.html for scope and exclusions.
Checkout is not connected. A request is not an order or payment. Agree on scope, delivery timing and cancellation/refund terms before payment.

## Important limitations

CommerceLint provides technical diagnostics. It does not guarantee indexing, inclusion in an AI product surface, recommendations, purchases, traffic, rankings, or revenue. Findings must be validated against the live storefront and the current requirements of relevant platforms.

## Data handling

Pasted HTML is analyzed locally in the browser. Optional production analytics load only after the visitor grants consent. Audit requests use the visitor's email client and are not sent until the visitor reviews and sends the prepared message.
